svg.title: The bus interface page after adding an AXI4-Stream initiator, with numbered callouts: the interface type and its name, TVALID, TREADY and TDATA matched by name, the optional TSTRB and TKEEP left empty, TLAST matched, and TID, TDEST and TUSER left empty.
svg.desc: The bus interface page after adding an AXI4-Stream initiator, with numbered callouts: the interface type and its name, TVALID, TREADY and TDATA matched by name, the optional TSTRB and TKEEP left empty, TLAST matched, and TID, TDEST and TUSER left empty.

g.text: Master is the initiator: the core sends the data, TVALID and TDATA are its outputs.
TVALID, TREADY and TDATA; TREADY is the one input, it comes back from the receiver.
TSTRB and TKEEP: this stream has no byte qualifiers, so nothing is mapped.
The last word of a burst; a receiver such as a DMA uses it to end a frame.
TID, TDEST and TUSER are not used by this core.
